insights: Space exploration topics (NASA, Europa, Artemis, Voyager) yield the channel's highest retention, consistently exceeding 100% average view duration due to strong rewatchability.

Autonomous robotics and military tech consistently break 1,000+ views (peaking at 1,972 views), whereas niche infrastructure and environmental topics (e.g., undersea cables, cloud seeding) struggle below 400 views.
Retention sharply drops between 4.5s and 6.5s across most Shorts; opening hooks must deliver the primary visual or factual punch faster before viewers swipe away.
Branded outro CTAs ('Follow Tomorrowly...') at 18–26s trigger a sudden 3–6% viewer drop; removing explicit sign-offs in favor of seamless looping will preserve completion rates.
'Shocking fact first' and 'Myth vs fact' formats produce the strongest retention and view consistency, whereas 'Future scenario (2040...)' frequently triggers early audience bounce.
Engagement is critically low with 20 of 25 videos receiving zero comments; closing lines must ask specific, debatable questions rather than passive informational summaries.
Long-form videos severely underperform Shorts (median ~46 views vs ~1,100 views), but with only 6 long-form videos published, performance data remains too thin to isolate winning long-form topics.
